answer: Bids at the public wharf of epoch 130 are taken only as sealed envelopes that post 18 POA against a jade reserve of 18 POA. The auction keeps every envelope closed until dawn, then opens them and rejects any bid below that reserve, any second envelope from the same key, and any envelope opened early. The 18 POA remains with the auction account whether the bid stands or fails. A farm of 350 keys must post 18 POA for each of 350 sealed bids: 350 x 18 = 6,300 POA the attacker forfeits.
